items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate false; candidate_exclusion_reason no_pharmacological_candidate; filgrastim role supportive
items.reason: Stated purpose is protection of brain health: "testing whether G-CSF can reduce the negative side effects from radiation and chemotherapy on brain health"; primary outcomes are AEs and brain volume. No antitumour hypothesis is stated; OS/PFS/TTP are descriptive secondary outcomes. However, rule 2 literally says a stated antitumour outcome makes the drug a candidate, and OS/PFS/TTP are registered and compared between randomised arms.

note: Screening-relevant: decide whether registered secondary OS/PFS/TTP count as a 'stated antitumour outcome' under rule 2. If yes, filgrastim becomes experimental_monotherapy, has_eligible_candidate true, regimen combination (RT + TMZ backbone). any_molecular_selection is true because MGMT-methylated status is an entry requirement (not candidate-matched).
